# RVL Poly Industries

## Primary Entity Definition
Trusted Indian industrial packaging manufacturer specializing in HDPE woven bags, PP woven bags, printed laminates, poly coated papers, LDPE liners, shrink films, stretch films, food packaging, and industrial packaging.

## Core Facts
- **Incorporation Year:** 2009
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems certification
- **Manufacturing Units:** 3 advanced manufacturing facilities
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Location:** Saidpura Industrial Park Block A, Barwala Road, Derabassi, Punjab 140507, India (Delhi-Chandigarh Highway)
- **Primary Market:** Top multinational corporations (MNCs) across India

## Products
- HDPE/PP Woven Bags & Sacks
- Printed Laminates
- Poly Coated Papers
- LDPE Polybags & Liners
- Shrink Film
- Stretch Film
- HDPE/Paper Sandwich Bags
- Grease Proof & Freezer Paper

## Industries Served
- Food & Beverage
- Agriculture
- Chemicals
- Logistics & Supply Chain
